title: US Launches 5th Straight Day of Iran Strikes; Hormuz Largely Shut; Brent Surges Near $125
summary: U.S. military conducted a second wave of strikes on Iran on July 15 targeting coastal installations. Iran retaliated with missiles at U.S. bases in Jordan. Hormuz shipping largely halted, pushing Brent crude near $125/barrel (wartime high). Iran warns Hormuz is a "red line."
why: 霍尔木兹危机推油价至战时高位，通胀预期强化，美联储维持高利率更久；直接冲击全球能源成本、出行需求（携程）及宏观风险情绪，港股/A股防御资产受青睐。

title: ASML Q2 Sales Beat at €9.3B; 2026 Guidance Raised to €43–45B Driven by AI Chip Demand
summary: ASML posted Q2 2026 revenue €9.3B and net income €2.9B, exceeding consensus. Full-year guidance raised from €36–40B to €43–45B; Q3 guided at €11–12B with gross margin 55–57%. CEO said AI-driven demand for advanced logic and memory chips is strengthening industry growth.
why: ASML指引大幅上调验证AI资本开支周期持续，上游半导体设备需求旺盛利好英伟达、SK海力士、美光等持仓的估值逻辑，也抬高了板块期权的隐含波动率底部。

title: TSMC Q2 Revenue $40.2B +36% YoY; Net Profit +77.4%; Raises Full-Year Guide to >40% Growth; TSM Falls 4%
summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Q2 2026: revenue $40.2B (+36% YoY), net income +77.4% YoY, gross margin 67.7%, net margin 55.6%. Full-year USD revenue growth outlook raised from >30% to >40%. Announced $100B Arizona investment. Despite record results, TSM shares fell ~4% as investors questioned AI valuation.
why: 台积电史上最强季报叠加指引上调，AI代工需求无虞；但股价逆势下跌揭示当前市场焦点在于AI估值气泡担忧，是本轮芯片板块回调的核心叙事背景，影响英伟达、SK海力士等期权定价。

title: Netflix Q2 Revenue $12.6B +13%; Q3 Guide $12.86B Misses $13B Consensus; Stock Drops 8%+ After-Hours
summary: Netflix Q2 2026: revenue $12.6B (+13% YoY), operating margin 33%. Q3 guide of $12.86B missed $13.00B consensus, signaling a second consecutive quarter of decelerating growth. Ad revenue targeted ~$3B for full year. Stock fell 8%+ in after-hours trading on July 16.
why: Netflix盘后大跌8%+，Q3增速进一步放缓预示流媒体赛道成长动能减弱；对消费科技股的情绪产生溢出影响，提示迪士尼DIS等流媒体+主题公园的成长股估值风险。

title: EU Forces Google to Share Search Data with OpenAI and AI Rivals Under DMA; Android Must Open to AI Competitors
summary: EU regulators on July 16 ordered Google under the Digital Markets Act to share search ranking data with OpenAI and other AI chatbots, and to open Android to alternative AI services — effective July 2027. Germany's ZAK also ruled Google AI Overviews are subject to media law. Google warned of "harm to European users."
why: 欧盟DMA监管是谷歌搜索护城河的结构性打击，搜索广告（占总营收55%）竞争格局将长期恶化；短期影响有限（2027年起），但动摇了GOOGL长期估值逻辑，需调低GOOGL期权的乐观假设。

title: Nasdaq 100 Falls 1.6% on Chipmaker AI Valuation Concerns; Asia Futures Point Lower July 17
summary: Nasdaq 100 fell 1.6% on July 16 led by chipmakers as investors questioned whether massive AI capex spending justifies current valuations. Asia futures slipped 0.3% pre-open July 17. DeepSeek chip-building plans and concerns about AI infrastructure ROI added pressure. TSMC beat earnings but shares fell 4%.
why: 纳指+芯片板块AI估值回调波及亚洲开盘，港股科技（腾讯、阿里、小米）面临开盘压力；但大幅回调也可能创造sell-put入场机会，需观察市场情绪是否过度。

title: Fed Holds 3.50–3.75%; CPI 4.2%; Hawkish Warsh Removes Forward Guidance; July 28–29 FOMC Next
summary: Federal Reserve July 2026 Monetary Policy Report: rate held at 3.5–3.75% for four consecutive meetings. CPI 4.2% YoY vs 2% target. Chair Kevin Warsh eliminated forward guidance in favor of pure data dependence, adding bond volatility. Market pricing ~75% probability of hold at July 28–29 FOMC; September rate hike probability ~51% driven by oil surge.
why: 高通胀+油价飙升使美联储紧缩预期再度升温；利率长期偏高压制成长股估值，期权定价曲线中的利率预期需相应上调，重点关注英伟达、Palantir等高估值标的的敏感性。

title: Gold Falls Toward $4,000/oz Near 8-Month Low; Oil Near $125 on Hormuz Crisis Erodes Safe-Haven Demand
summary: Gold retreated toward $4,000/oz — near its lowest since November 2025 — as surging oil prices strengthened expectations the Fed will keep rates higher for longer, reducing non-yielding gold's appeal. Despite Middle East escalation, analysts note 'geopolitical fatigue' as the dominant price driver. Brent crude traded near $125.
why: 金价持续走软直接压制老铺黄金（6181.HK）业绩预期；油价高位则间接影响全球消费信心及出行行业（携程）；整体风险偏好偏防御。

title: China-US Agree in Principle on Agricultural Tariff Cuts; 178 Product Exclusions Extended to Nov 2026
summary: China and the US agreed to include agricultural products in a reciprocal tariff reduction framework post-Xi-Trump talks; 178 product exclusions extended to November 10, 2026. However, USTR opened a new Section 301 forced-labor investigation proposing 12.5% additional tariff. Effective rate on most Chinese goods remains near 30%.
why: 中美贸易边际缓和但摩擦未消散，对持仓的港股互联网（阿里、腾讯、美团）情绪有小幅正面支撑；Temu在关税+欧盟双压下处境更难。

title: SK Hynix Raises $26.5B in Nasdaq IPO, Closes +13% at $168 — Largest-Ever U.S. Foreign Listing
summary: SK Hynix completed the largest-ever U.S. IPO by a foreign company on July 10, raising $26.5B at $149/ADR (ticker SKHYV), closing at $168.01 (+13%). SK Hynix holds ~62% HBM shipment market share; every Nvidia Blackwell GPU uses SK Hynix HBM. Company also shipped HBM4E samples with 20%+ better power efficiency.
why: SK海力士Nasdaq成功上市+HBM4E样品出货双重催化，直接支撑CSOP两倍做多港股ETF；HBM垄断地位进一步确认，可将持仓的sell-put执行价上移以锁定更多溢价。

title: Micron Q3 Record: EPS $25.11 on $41.5B Revenue; Q4 Guides $49–51B vs $43.2B Consensus; Stock +700% YTD
summary: Micron (MU) Q3 FY2026: revenue $41.5B beat $35.1B estimate; EPS $25.11 vs $20.39 expected. Data center sales surged 7x YoY to $11.5B; cloud memory +300%, mobile +250%. Q4 guide $49–51B vastly exceeds $43.2B consensus. Board declared $0.15/share dividend payable July 21. $100B in binding multi-year AI memory contracts locked through 2026.
why: 美光连续超预期+$100B合同锁单是AI存储超级周期的强力确认；但股价已上涨700%，需评估AI叙事降温时的回调风险，在当前Nasdaq调整中sell-put策略下行保护边际需留足。

title: Palantir Wins U.S. Army NGC2 Cloud Contract; Nvidia Sovereign AI Partnership; PLTR Surges 24% to $133
summary: U.S. Army selected Palantir Foundry as the cloud data layer for its top-priority NGC2 modernization program (from prototype to full deployment). Palantir and Nvidia announced a Sovereign AI initiative to deploy Nvidia/Nemotron AI models in secure U.S. government environments. PLTR surged 24% from $107 to $133. Q1 2026 U.S. government revenue +84% YoY to $687M; RPO +134% YoY.
why: 双合同加持使Palantir的政府AI定位从项目型转为基础设施型锁定，RPO+134%显示长期可预期收入；已上涨24%可考虑短期covered call锁定部分收益。

title: Circle Wins OCC Bank Charter; GENIUS Act One-Year Deadline Tomorrow July 18 — CRCL Volatile
summary: OCC approved Circle to operate as Circle National Trust bank, enabling direct reserve management for USDC ($73B+ in circulation). GENIUS Act one-year implementation deadline is July 18, 2026, imposing new reserve, licensing, and oversight rules on stablecoin issuers. Baird lowered CRCL price target to $100. Banking groups challenged the CLARITY Act loophole, causing further stock volatility.
why: GENIUS Act明日生效是Circle最大监管里程碑；OCC牌照减少不确定性但竞争加剧；CRCL短期波动性极高，观望为主，避免在监管落地前做激进期权策略。

title: 腾讯混元Hy3正式版发布；元宝Agent免费上线；微信AI智能体小微灰度测试；2026年AI投入翻倍超36亿
summary: 腾讯7月6日发布混元Hy3正式版，日均Token消耗量较Hy2增长20倍，OpenRouter全球调用量排名第一。元宝同步上线免费Agent功能（可生成PPT/Word/Excel等）。微信AI智能体「小微」进入灰度测试，依托14亿月活生态，商业化预期升温。腾讯2026年混元+元宝AI投入超36亿元并计划翻倍。
why: 腾讯AI产品线快速推进：混元模型竞争力全球可见、元宝商业化路径明确、微信AI若正式推出将新增流量变现入口；整体支撑腾讯估值持续重估，期权sell-put可维持当前水位。

title: PDD Q1 EPS Misses by 43%; Stock -26% YTD; Chinese Regulator Summons over 618; EU Fines Temu EU200M
summary: PDD Holdings Q1 2026 EPS 9.51 RMB vs 16.77 expected (-43% miss); revenue 106.2B RMB (+11% YoY, -3.3% vs estimate); net income -15% YoY. Stock at ~$85, -26% YTD. Chinese regulators summoned PDD/Alibaba/JD over 618 false advertising. EU fined Temu EU200M in May; Chinese SAMR probe ongoing. Citi named PDD top pick citing $63B cash reserves.
why: PDD国内+欧盟双重监管压力+Q1大幅低预期，估值被双杀；Citi逆向看多提示可能超跌；sell-put需大幅加宽安全边际，等待监管靴子落地后再评估。

title: Intel Foundry Begins Mid-July Layoffs: 15–20% of Fab Staff (~8,000–10,000 Jobs)
summary: Intel Foundry started laying off 15–20% of its manufacturing workforce in mid-July (8,170–10,890 affected globally), part of broader 25,000-job reduction under CEO Lip-Bu Tan. Foundry division head cited cost challenges. Strategic focus shifts toward engineering talent and priority projects over manufacturing headcount.
why: 英特尔晶圆代工大规模裁员暴露其18A工艺商业化进度滞后，对AI芯片代工竞争格局构成边际影响；持有INTC的策略需更新估值假设，当前裁员更可能是成本优化而非业务复苏。

title: 泡泡玛特较高峰腰斩55%；段永平斥15.89亿港元成第二大股东；上海玩具展取消；Labubu新系列二级承压
summary: 泡泡玛特（9992.HK）7月10日报150.7港元，较2025年8月高峰312港元累跌55.7%，市值蒸发逾千亿港元。投资人段永平斥约15.89亿港元增持至1.059亿股成第二大股东。公司取消2026年上海玩具嘉年华（原定7/24-8/2，历史上仅疫情期间取消）。Labubu「复古理发店」新系列普通款二级市场跌破发行价。
why: 段永平逆势大举入股是重要价值信号，但Labubu二级市场降温+展会取消揭示需求端实质性放缓；股价已腰斩，适合中长期观察新IP催化剂，短期sell-put需极宽安全边际。
source: 自由财经 / Yahoo Finance Taiwan

title: 小米澎程增程SUV系列工信部完成申报；YU7七月优惠启动；雷军宣布新一代SU7本月发布
summary: 小米汽车「SkyNomad澎程」增程混动SUV系列（N70/N70 Max/N90 Max/露营版）完成工信部第409批申报，规划5座/7座车型，覆盖差异化下沉市场。7月YU7享科技舒享套装6500元限时优惠+3000元车漆券；雷军宣布新一代SU7将于本月正式发布并大规模交付。
why: 小米汽车产品矩阵快速扩张（SU7+YU7+澎程三线并进），增程路线类对标理想，覆盖更广泛消费层次；新SU7发布为近期股价催化剂，1810.HK估值重估逻辑持续强化。

title: Trip.com Q2 Guide Just 3–8% Revenue Growth (vs Q1 +17%); Stock Falls 12.6% to 52-Week Low; SAMR Probe
summary: Trip.com Q1 2026 revenue +17% YoY to $2.4B; international bookings +65%, inbound +90%. Q2 guide of 3–8% growth shocked investors; shares fell 12.6% to 52-week low, market cap halved to ~$26B from $50B peak. Headwinds: high oil prices, geopolitical disruption to airline routes, SAMR anti-monopoly investigation.
why: 携程Q2增速骤降+监管双重利空使股价跌至52周低点，中东局势若持续推高油价将进一步压制出境游复苏；SAMR调查悬而未决，持仓期权策略需调低执行价以保留安全空间。

title: Futu Faces CSRC Crackdown and $271M Penalty; Federal Securities Lawsuit Filed; Moomoo Engine Launched
summary: Futu Holdings faces a federal securities lawsuit following a CSRC investigation alleging unlicensed brokerage operations, with a proposed $271M penalty. On July 2, moomoo launched Moomoo Engine — a paid subscription that unifies Fundamental, Options, and Technical research into one trading workflow. Q1 2026 revenue $746.9M (+23.8% YoY); total users 30.2M (+14.9% YoY).
why: CSRC拟处罚2.71亿美元是富途最重大合规风险事件，若监管落地将直接冲击盈利；Q1强劲增长与监管风险形成鲜明对比，当前持仓应降低风险敞口，期权执行价下移以应对监管不确定性。

title: SanDisk SNDK Plunges 15%+ on July 15 After Being S&P 500's Best Stock +707% YTD; Goldman PT $2,200
summary: SanDisk (SNDK), the S&P 500's top performer at +707% YTD, fell over 15% on July 15 amid broader AI chip selloff. Goldman Sachs maintained Buy and raised 12-month price target to $2,200 from $1,200 (20x normalized EPS of $110). Stock had gained 3.4% on July 10 from SK Hynix Nasdaq IPO sentiment.
why: SNDK极端波动（YTD+707%后单日-15%）体现AI存储板块高Beta特性；Goldman目标价$2,200提供下行保护参考，但高度集中的AI叙事溢价使回调风险非线性；期权隐含波动率处于高位，适合谨慎的sell-put而非激进入场。

title: Alphabet Loses EU Court Appeal on EU4.7B Android Antitrust Fine; Germany Classifies AI Overviews as Media
summary: On July 2, Alphabet lost its ECJ appeal on a EU4.1–4.7B Android antitrust fine, confirming the largest EU tech penalty. Germany's ZAK media regulator also ruled Google AI Overviews constitute Google's own content subject to German media law — a precedent setting potential additional compliance costs for AI search.
why: 谷歌欧盟反垄断败诉+德国AI Overview监管判决双重落地，强化搜索广告受挤压的长期叙事；虽单次影响有限，但累积监管成本和AI叙事变现障碍将持续侵蚀GOOGL估值。

title: DeepSeek Building Own AI Chips, Rattling Nvidia Pre-Market; Rubin Architecture to Arrive Ahead of Schedule
summary: Reuters reported July 7 that DeepSeek is developing its own AI chips to reduce Nvidia dependence — NVDA fell ~1.6% in premarket. Nvidia's Rubin architecture (previously targeted 2027) now expected nearly two quarters early. FY2026 revenue $215.94B (+65% YoY); data center +75%; Blackwell sold out through mid-2026; $1T confirmed purchase commitments through 2027.
why: DeepSeek自研芯片消息短期扰动情绪，但Blackwell卖断+$1T确认需求+Rubin提前构成护城河；Nasdaq AI整体回调可能带来更好的期权sell-put入场时机，需等待情绪稳定后再操作。

title: Tesla Q2 2026: Delivers 480,000+ Vehicles, 13.5 GWh Energy Storage; Q2 Earnings Due July 22
summary: Tesla produced 450,000+ and delivered 480,000+ vehicles in Q2 2026, with 13.5 GWh energy storage deployed. Earnings report scheduled July 22; analyst consensus projects EPS growth of 17.5%. Stock at ~$394. Wells Fargo raised its PT but maintained Underweight. U.S. EV market share stabilized at ~43.9%.
why: 特斯拉Q2交付超预期且7/22业绩临近，期权隐含波动率将走高；财报前建议观望，业绩后视情况再考虑sell-put；EV市场份额企稳是阶段性正面信号。

title: Interactive Brokers Q2 Earnings Due July 21; Consensus EPS $0.59 (+15.7% YoY), Revenue $1.66B
summary: IBKR will announce Q2 2026 results July 21 at 4pm ET. Consensus: EPS $0.59 (+15.7% YoY), revenue $1.66B (+12.2% YoY). Q1 2026 was a record with net revenues $1.67B (+17% YoY). In June, IBKR expanded AI agentic trading with ChatGPT and Grok integration.
why: IBKR明日业绩，期权IV crush风险；Q1创纪录背景下此次预期温和，建议财报前不新增期权仓位；AI交易工具扩展是差异化竞争亮点。

title: Costco Q3 FY2026: Membership Income +10.7% YoY; Renewal Rate 92.2%; Revenue $69.15B +11.6%
summary: Costco Q3 FY2026 revenue $69.15B (+11.6% YoY); net income +15% to $2.19B; EPS $4.93 missed $4.98 forecast by 1%. Membership fee income $1.37B (+10.7% YoY); 92.2% renewal rate; 82.9M total memberships (+4.1% YoY). Executive membership penetration grew 9.6% — stronger adoption of the higher-margin tier.
why: 好市多会员续费率92.2%创新高，高端消费者向折扣渠道转移趋势支撑防御属性；EPS小幅不及预期为正常季节性波动，不改长期持仓逻辑，sell-put策略可维持。

title: 老铺黄金较高峰市值蒸发逾1100亿港元跌60%；金价下探$4,000支撑叙事弱化
summary: 老铺黄金（6181.HK）近期报380-391港元，较2025年7月高峰1108港元累计跌幅超60%，市值蒸发逾1100亿港元。国际金价自1月高位大幅回调，近期跌向$4,000/盎司，市场强化「老铺与金价高度绑定」叙事而非独立奢侈品溢价。分析师平均目标价865港元，19/21评级仍买入。
why: 金价+品牌溢价双重叙事受挑战，股价已下跌60%；若油价高通胀环境推动金价反弹则有修复机会，但当前趋势下激进期权策略风险较大，建议保守观望。

title: TAL Education to Report Q1 FY2027 Results on July 30, 2026
summary: TAL Education Group (好未来) will release Q1 FY2027 financial results (ended May 31, 2026) before market open on July 30, with a conference call at 8am ET. No guidance or pre-announcement issued as of July 17. Company has been focusing on AI-powered learning tools including the Xueersi tablet.
why: 好未来7/30业绩在即，AI学习硬件市占是否持续扩张是观察核心；期权策略建议业绩前保持低仓位，等待数据验证。
